bio.text: Zuhdi Jasser is the Republican candidate for Arizona's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21 primary.
Jasser earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and a medical degree from the Medical College of Wisconsin in 1992, and is a physician.

Jasser served in the U.S. Navy; according to his campaign website, he was an officer and was honorably discharged in 1999 after 11 years of service, and he later founded the Jasser Center for Comprehensive Care in Phoenix.
Jasser founded the American Islamic Forum for Democracy and co-founded the Muslim Reform Movement, and has been affiliated with the Maricopa County Board of Health.
